text:
julia: Heads up — planning a schema rollout tomorrow 03:00 UTC that renames some audit fields (actor_id -> principal.id, action -> verb) and introduces a `schema_version` top-level field. This touches customer-facing events and SIEM mappings. Need a rollback playbook + validation checklist ASAP. Anyone on for a quick sync?

ana: please do not rename public-facing fields without a compatibility shim. We should emit both names for at least 30 days and add `deprecated_fields` metadata.

mike: +1. Also: KMS integration note — the encrypted payload field name must remain `encrypted_blob` for older consumers; changing that will break HSM clients. If we must, add `encrypted_blob_v2` but keep current field.

kevin: For the RBAC change planned next sprint, logs must include both new `principal.roles` and the legacy `role_ids`. That will help mapping during rollout. Example event we can use for validation:

```json
{
  "schema_version": "2026-03-21-1",
  "event_name": "user.login",
  "principal": { "id": "u_123", "roles": ["admin"] },
  "legacy": { "actor_id": "u_123", "role_ids": ["r_admin"] },
  "verb": "authenticate",
  "encrypted_blob": "<base64>...",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-21T03:00:00Z"
}
```

randall: Sampling concern: we currently sample high-volume events at 1%. That will hide any mapping regressions. Recommend disabling sampling for `user.*` and `session.*` for a 48h window around the deploy. Also bump log retention + export to a temporary S3 bucket for forensic replay.

sarah: Canary plan: route 1% of traffic to the new schema for 2 hours, compare counts and parity metrics in Redwood Console (per-route token parity + event name mapping). Create an alert if parity < 99.9% or if downstream SIEM drop rate > 0.1%.

ana: I'll draft an alias map for event names and field synonyms and open a docs PR to update customer-facing examples and release notes. We should also add a migration note to the public changelog with a `how to map` snippet.

sec-bot: Automated scan: proposed schema change touches PII fields and KMS-wrapped blobs. Recommend KMS key rotation assessment and confirm envelope encryption semantics remain unchanged.

julia: Action items summary: 1) julia -> write rollback playbook (include database flag flip + feature-gate) 2) ana -> compatibility mapping + docs PR 3) kevin -> validate KMS field stability and HSM clients 4) sarah -> set canary and alerts in Console 5) randall -> disable sampling and increase retention for 48h 6) mike -> run quick SIEM consumer smoke tests. Can everyone ack by EOD?

mike: ack. I'll run SIEM smoke tests and post results here.

ana: on it, will open PR and ping infra.

kevin: validating KMS now, will confirm by 17:00 PT.

randall: will schedule retention bump and disable sampling 30m before deploy.

sarah: canary configured, dashboards cloned.

julia: thanks — I'll draft the rollback steps in the `#eng-security` playbook and share a short runbook snippet here when done. If anyone thinks we should postpone to the following week, speak now.

mike: doesn't look risky if we keep aliases and the canary. fine to proceed.

julia: ok locking plan. Ill post the rollbook + validation checklist in the thread in 20m. :thumbsup:
